persona.title: Pretend you are…
persona.text: Pretend you are Mercy, 22, in Eldoret. You cook supper for your family: Mama, Baba and your little brother Kevin. Every evening someone asks what is for supper, and every week you walk back to the shop because you forgot something. Today you want to plan the week's suppers and make one shopping list.

lines: Welcome. This short video explains an app called Our Table. In about three minutes you will know what it is for and how to use it.
First, the problem. Every evening the same question: what is for supper? And every week, the same trip back to the shop, because you forgot the onions.
Our Table answers both. You keep the dinners your family really cooks. You put one on each night of the week. Then the app makes one shopping list for the whole week.

Who uses it? Anyone who cooks for a family. It was made in America, so the examples are American food, and the word dinner means the evening meal, what we call supper. Your own dinners can be githeri, pilau or ugali and sukuma. There is no money in this app.

lines.t: At the bottom are the tabs. Recipes is your list of dinners. This week is the seven nights. Shopping is the list for the shop.
At the top, a helper line suggests the next thing to do.
Under it is your Level. Level 1 shows only recipes and the week. Level 2 adds the Shopping tab. Level 3 adds sharing. Tap the Level line and choose, any time. Nothing is lost.

lines: On the Recipes tab, tap New recipe. Type the name, like Pilau. Choose a picture if you like. Under Ingredients, write what to buy, one thing on each line: rice, beef, onions, pilau masala. How to make it is optional. Then tap Save.
If you are in a hurry, the box Put your own dinners in lets you type only the names. You can add the ingredients later with Edit.
Tap any recipe to see it. There you find Made it tonight, Put it on a night, and Edit. And Delete, which asks first.
Now the This week tab. It shows Monday to Sunday. Tap a night and pick a dinner. Leave a night blank for leftovers or eating out.
Fill the blanks for me puts your dinners on the empty nights for you. Clear the week empties all seven nights.

Below the week is Family favorites. Type the names of the people at your table and tap Add. Then each person can give a dinner a heart if they love it, or a thumbs down if they do not like it. Fill the blanks then skips any dinner with a thumbs down.
You give the heart or thumbs down when you open a recipe, under Who likes it. Or tap Who likes it, pass the phone around, and everyone chooses.
Now the shopping list. On Level 1, after two nights are planned, a button appears: Make my shopping list from these dinners. On Level 2, tap Build the shopping list.

The list joins the ingredients from every night and sorts them by part of the shop. Tick things off as you buy them. To add anything else, like soap or charcoal, type it in the Add box at the bottom of the list.

Made a mistake? Every thing on the list has an ✕ to take it off. Remove the ticked ones and Clear the list are under the list. At the bottom of Recipes, Clear or start over can clear the week, the list, or everything. Each clear asks first, and Undo puts it back.
Everything stays on this phone. There is no account.
To start again, delete your own recipes, then take the tour again under the question mark button and choose Start fresh. The test tells you exactly how.
In the test, you will be Mercy, planning supper for her family in Eldoret. Take your time, and if something is confusing, say so. Confusing parts are exactly what we want to find.

challenge.intro: Now you are Mercy in Eldoret. The app must start empty. Nobody will tell you which button to press: use what you learned (the Level line at the top may matter). You do not need to send anything. When you finish, tap Check my work.
challenge.start: Use the NORMAL app link (not the 🧪 test copy). Open Our Table. 1) If the welcome tour shows by itself, tap 'skip the tour' → '✨ Start fresh with my own' → OK. If a menu then asks 'What would you like to do?', tap '📖 My recipes'. 2) On the 📖 Recipes tab, scroll to the bottom and tap '🧹 Clear or start over…' → '🧹 Start over — clear everything' → OK. This clears every recipe, the week, the shopping list and the family names. If it says 'Nothing to clear — the app is already empty' instead, tap Close: you are ready. The Recipes list is now empty. (New 13 Oct: Our Table v1.17 has this button; before, you had to delete things one by one.)

tasks.text: Put in three dinners your family really eats, each as its own recipe: Githeri, Ugali and sukuma, and Pilau.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('dj_ourtable_v1')||'null');if(!d||!Array.isArray(d.recipes))return false;var W=['githeri','ugali','pilau'];var ns=d.recipes.filter(function(r){return !/\(example\)/i.test(String(r.name||''))}).map(function(r){return String(r.name||'').toLowerCase()});return W.every(function(w){return ns.some(function(n){return n.indexOf(w)>=0&&W.filter(function(x){return n.indexOf(x)>=0}).length===1})})}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Three dinners means three separate recipes, not one recipe with three names. Look on the Recipes tab.

tasks.text: Write down what you must buy for Pilau, as its ingredients, one thing on each line: rice, beef, onions, pilau masala.
tasks.hint: Open the Pilau recipe and tap Edit. The 'Ingredients' box takes one thing on each line.

tasks.text: Plan at least four nights of this week. The same dinner can go on more than one night. Sunday must be Pilau.
tasks.hint: Use the This week tab. Tap a night to choose a dinner (a night that already has one opens it: tap 🔁 Swap). Check that Pilau is on Sun, not Sat.

tasks.text: Put in who eats at your table: Mama, Baba and Kevin. Kevin does not like Githeri: record his 👎 for it in the app.
tasks.hint: Names go in '👪 Family favorites' on the This week tab. Then open the Githeri recipe and look under 'Who likes it?'.

tasks.text: Make the shopping list from this week's dinners. You also need charcoal: add it to the list.
tasks.hint: The shopping list is made FROM the week, so plan the nights first. If you cannot see the Shopping tab, tap the Level line at the top. Extra things go in the Add box at the bottom of the list.

tasks.text: You already have onions at home. Take the onions off the shopping list, but keep everything else on it.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('dj_ourtable_v1')||'null');if(!d||!Array.isArray(d.shop)||!d.shop.length)return false;var P=d.pantry||{},O=/onion|(vi|ki)tunguu(?!\s*saumu)/,lo=function(s){return String(s||'').toLowerCase()},rs={};(d.recipes||[]).forEach(function(r){rs[r.id]=r});var src=Object.keys(P).some(function(k){return O.test(lo(k))})||Object.keys(d.week||{}).some(function(k){var r=rs[d.week[k]];return !!r&&(r.ing||[]).some(function(i){return O.test(lo(i))})});var left=d.shop.some(function(x){return O.test(lo(x.text))&&!P[x.key]&&!x.done});var rest=d.shop.some(function(x){return !O.test(lo(x.text))});return src&&!left&&rest}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: On the 🧺 Shopping tab, each thing has an ✕ to take it off (or 🏠 Have it). If onions are on the list twice, take off both. If you take off the wrong thing, tap ↩︎ Undo.

ownWords.question: In your own words, what is this app for?
keyIdeas: keep the dinners your family really cooks, with what to buy for each
plan a dinner for each night of the week
it makes one shopping list from the whole week

daily.task: Plan tomorrow’s dinner in Our Table: put a meal on tomorrow (or change it), or add one item to the shopping list.

explore.name: 📖 Recipes
explore.find: Open Our Table. You start here.
explore.try: Search “beef”, then search “zzz”. Tap each kind button (Quick, Sunday…) and All.

explore.name: 🍲 One recipe
explore.try: Tap ✓ Made it tonight, 📅 Put it on a night, 👩‍🍳 Cook (go to the last step), and ❤️ / 👎 in Who likes it. Close.

explore.name: ✏️ The recipe page
explore.find: Tap ＋ New recipe, or ✏️ Edit on a recipe.
explore.try: Fill every box: name, picture, tags, ingredients, how to make it, time. Try Save with no name. Delete a recipe you made.

explore.name: 📥 Bring your dinners over
explore.try: Paste a few lines of any recipe and see what it makes. Try it with the box empty.

explore.name: 📅 This week
explore.find: Tap 📅 This week at the bottom.
explore.try: Tap an empty night and pick a recipe. On another night type your own words (tick “keep as a recipe”). Try 🔁 Swap, Clear and Leave blank.

explore.name: ✨ Week buttons
explore.try: Tap ✨ Fill the blanks, change How many at the table, open 👪 Family favorites, then Clear the week. Look at 💬 Text it — don’t send.

explore.name: 🧺 Shopping
explore.try: Tick some things. Add “milk” and “paper towels”. Try 🏠 Have it, Need it and Untick all. Look at 🖨 Print and 💬 Text — don’t send.

explore.name: 🟩 Helper card & Level
explore.find: The green card and the Level line at the top.
explore.try: Tap the green card’s button. Change the Level to 1, 2 and 3 and see what comes and goes.

explore.name: 🏠 Start menu · Plan a meal
explore.find: Tap the round ?, then 🏠 Start menu.
explore.try: Tap Plan a meal: pick a day, a kind of dinner, then a recipe. Check it is on This week.

explore.name: ❓ The round ? button
explore.find: Tap the round ? in the bottom corner.
explore.try: Open every line in it: Aa (size), ✨ Ask an AI, 🌉 More from Daraja, 🎬 Take the tour again. Close it. Leave “Start fresh” for the very end.
